title: Approve the Home page composition
question: Three compositions of the Folk Woodblock world. Pick the one to build against, or say what to combine.

options.label: The Poster
options.thesis: One print: name and prices stacked vertical on the left, the house in section, the phone on a red banner.
options.viewport: Vertical cut-letter name and price stack on the left, the house section center-right, full-width red CALL banner at the bottom, nav as small caps top right.
options.risk: Least like a website: the nav is tiny and the second fold is unproven; the flag is a small corner print.

options.label: The Site
options.thesis: A woodblock-printed waving flag band crowns the page; headline left, house right, a brass ledger of prices across, review seals in the second fold.
options.viewport: Flag band, then header with shield mark, nav with star ornaments, red CALL button; hero headline 'Know the house before you buy it.' with two buttons left, house section right; full-width brass price ledger; review seals begin the second fold.
options.risk: Most conventional topology of the three; the flag band must be the live waving-flag canvas printed as a woodblock, not a static image, or it goes flat.

options.label: Print in Progress
options.lineage: same world, the print-order reveal as the fold's subject
options.thesis: The house is printing block by block as you arrive, registration marks at the corners, and your price ticket sits beside it.
options.viewport: Headline 'Every system. One print.' top-left; a huge house section across the center with red and navy already printed, brass printing halfway, keyblock arriving; right, a ticket-framed calculator: sqft slider, termite checkbox, $450 in red, CALL button, 'Book this inspection'; brass credential strip along the bottom.
options.risk: The reveal must be built for real (SVG blocks registering in print order on load and scroll); it also puts the calculator on Home, which makes the Services page a pricing-table detail rather than the only price surface.
